about: The communion antiphon of the Second Sunday of Advent, made of two places in Baruch. The city is to rise and look for where the joy comes from — not toward itself, but toward God.

s01.translation: Jerusalem, arise, stand on high, and behold the joy that will come to you from your God.

translation_citations.title: The Missal for the Laity (1846)
